title: Epiphanies
html_source:
Not religious. Joyce considered an epihany to be an awareness of the special in the mundane: an object, an instance, an interaction and that he had a duty to highlight the nature and types of epiphanies.

“Epiphanies” was also the proposed title for “Dubliners”.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Joyce defines epiphanies in Stephen Hero: a sudden spiritual manifestation. Epiphanies are to be recorded by the man of letters with extreme care, seeing that they themselves are the most delicate and evanescent moments.

Forty of the epiphanies collected by Joyce have survived and have been publish posthumously.
